name: Torrid-Strath
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws solar wind erosion patterns, patient as erosion itself.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Instruments disagree about the exotic matter deposit: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
